applicabilityBasis.summary: scrvUSD is an ERC-4626 savings-vault share redeemable for an accrued amount of underlying crvUSD. Borrower-interest profit distributions increase the value attributable to shares, so it represents a value-accruing vault position rather than a token maintained at a fixed monetary redemption value. This is distinct from the separate GENIUS assessment of the dollar-targeted crvUSD underlying.

genius.notes: Reviewed 2026-10-07. The official documentation describes an ERC-4626 vault holding crvUSD without rehypothecation or external strategies and receiving crvUSD borrowing-interest profits through the RewardsHandler. Withdrawals deliver the share entitlement to underlying crypto assets, not a legal issuer promise to pay a fixed amount of national currency or currency-denominated bank deposits. The savings share is independently assessed and does not inherit parent authorization. This non-payment-token assessment does not resolve securities, investment-product or intermediary-service regulation. No exact legal issuerEntity was identified or added.
